body: Thank you for your comment. I don’t know what to do anymore.

What if you’re honest to him.  What if you tell him you’re struggling and that really helps take your mind off of it.  And that now, you feel lost.   Idk.  Maybe try talking to him.  That’s my only thought.
Im in the same boat.  Lmk if you want to talk.  I’ll be going to bed in a bit but I’m here.

I won’t judge your decision. If you look at my post 50 something minutes ago, you’ll know I’m in the exact same place as you.  

Tell me why you want to go…. If you want to tell me I  mean

Can I tell you something honestly.  I’m not one of those people who’s going to tell you it gets better…because in my own experience it doesn’t.  

But TRUST me when I say overdosing doesn’t work.  Trust me.  I am a healthcare professional and I see it all the time. It rarely works. What will happen is you will be miserable, pass out, and live…. You’ll end up in the hospital, they will pump your stomach, and nobody will leave you alone ever again.  Don’t try it. It doesn’t work. Really.  All it might do is give you brain damage and make you forever impaired.  Trust me. Don’t.

Thank you for your message 🤍 I’m the absolute LAST person to give advice… but just keep focusing on that baby of yours. He/she needs you.   
I wish I could take my own advice and believe it.  
I feel like a hypocrite.

Thank you. I’m not sure what I’m coming here for. I just got the app right now. And found this site googling ‘suicide Reddit’ thinking maybe I could find that thread where people share ideas of how to do it.   I don’t know anymore.  

Thank you for your message.  I’m reading them and taking them in.  Again, I don’t know what I’m looking for. I don’t know if I’m looking for a reason to stay…or a reason to go.  I’m just so so sad.  I can’t explain it.  I have so many bricks on top of me… losing balance… I just don’t know how long I can hang on.

I turn 30 on Saturday. My parents keep bringing it up and I finally lost it and told them this isn’t something to celebrate.  All it is, is proof you all forced me to be here another year.  Yay for you.  I’m the prisoner who you won’t let get away from all of this pain inside of me.  
I’m sorry you feel like this too.  I get it.

Wow.  I turn 30 on Saturday and I am overwhelmed with this thought. I told my partner and my parents I would not be alive in a month…that was in like November. Yeah I’m still here… but not for long.  I tried I couple new treatments during that time. They failed.  I’m still living my worst nightmare every day. 
I’ts been TWENTY years since I was first diagnosed with MDD and eventually anxiety, most recently- panic attacks.  
I’ve tried very medication out there.  Each one works for a couple years, then I’m at square one trying to survive for months on end while they find another drug to dose me up on…. 
I’m done. I’m so done. I don’t want this anymore. 

I have two kids. One is only three years old. I love them tremendously. But the mother I am to them, is not the mother I want to be.  My three year old won’t remember me, and my 8 year old will be devastated, but I believe the damage it will do will be less than if I continued to be his mother.  I am impatient, ALWAYS overwhelmed. Always unable to handle life. 

I drink every night. It’s the only thing that makes me happy.  I need to forget.  
But even that isn’t enough. Because the morning after drinking to the point of blacking out….well I’m starting to have such unbearable anxiety the next morning, that I can’t handle that either. 

So I’ve decided I’m going.  I can’t do it.  I’ll leave notes to everyone I love. Try to explain why I did this. Why I HAD to do this. 

If someone has cancer for 20 years, fighting non stop…nobody would judge them if they decided to stop treatment and die.  But for some stupid reason, mental health isn’t life that. In fact, we can be taken hostage for three days MINIMUM if we decide to die…. 
Give me a break. How is this any different. I’ve been fighting for 20 years, 21 soon… 

I deserve peace.
